edges.reason: constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making caller the privileged owner.
registerBuyer writes registerbuyer[msg.sender], data keyed by caller.
transfer debits tokenBalances[msg.sender], caller-controlled balance.
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender], caller-controlled allowance.
placeorder records buyer as msg.sender and requires msg.sender to be registered.
addproduct stores the seller as msg.sender.
updateprice requires seller_products[_index]._seller == msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner (msg.sender == owner).
transferAnyERC20Token is gated by onlyOwner.
addTeamAndAdvisoryMembers is gated by onlyOwner.
checkTokenVesting uses now to compute lockup periods and locked/unlocked tokens (timestamp dependency).
now is compared against icoEndDate.add(lockupTime).
now is compared against preSaleEndDate.add(lockupTime).
transfer calls checkTokenVesting before moving balances.
transferFrom calls checkTokenVesting before moving balances.
transfer applies SafeMath sub/add on tokenBalances entries.
transferFrom applies SafeMath sub/add on tokenBalances entries.
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender] with sub.
approve writes the allowance value into allowed.
increaseApproval adds to allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
decreaseApproval subtracts from allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
placeorder calls transfer internally to pay the seller.
placeorder reads seller_products[product_index] for price, name and seller.
placeorder writes the new Order into orders.
placeorder increments order_counter used as the orders mapping key.
placeorder performs unchecked multiplication price*quantity before transferring tokens.
placeorder performs unchecked order_counter++ after state writes.
addproduct increments counter used as product key.
addproduct writes the new Product into seller_products.
addproduct writes products_price[counter].
updateprice writes seller_products[_index].price.
updateprice writes products_price[_index].
registerBuyer writes the Buyer struct into registerbuyer[msg.sender].
checkTokenVesting reads privateSaleBuyerTokens[sender] to compute lockups.
checkTokenVesting reads preSaleBuyerTokens[sender] to compute lockups.
checkTokenVesting reads teamMembers[sender] to compute lockups.
checkTokenVesting compares lockedTokens.add(tokens) against tokenBalances[sender].
addTeamAndAdvisoryMembers writes teamMembers[members[i]].
addTeamAndAdvisoryMembers performs sub/add on tokenBalances for owner and members.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external ERC20Interface call, an external callback surface.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards rescued tokens to the owner address.

normalization_plan.reason: the tokens parameter is the amount debited/added through transfer's tokenBalances updates.
the to parameter is the recipient key used in transfer's tokenBalances credit.
the _from parameter is the debited key in transferFrom.
the _to parameter is the credited key in transferFrom.
the _value parameter drives the SafeMath sub and allowance decrement in transferFrom.
the _spender parameter is the allowance index written by approve.
the _addedValue parameter is added into the allowed mapping by increaseApproval.
the _subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the allowed mapping by decreaseApproval.
the quantity parameter feeds the unchecked price multiplication in placeorder.
the product_index parameter indexes seller_products in placeorder.
the _price parameter is written into seller_products and products_price by updateprice.
the _index parameter selects the product entry updated by updateprice.
the members array supplies the addresses written into teamMembers.
the tokenAddress parameter is the target of the external ERC20Interface call.
the newOwner parameter becomes the owner state variable.
the wallet parameter is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor.
lockedTokens is computed and compared inside checkTokenVesting.
unlockedTokens is derived from privateSaleBuyerTokens inside checkTokenVesting.
lockupTime is computed from now-based arithmetic inside checkTokenVesting.
monthsPassedSinceICOEnd is derived from timestamp division in checkTokenVesting.
totalTeamShare is computed inside addTeamAndAdvisoryMembers before distribution.
oneTeamMemberShare is derived from the team share division used for transfers.
oldValue holds the previous allowance read in decreaseApproval.
